questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some bulls are rocks.

Some rocks are stones.

Conclusions:

(I): Some bulls are stones.

(II): All stones are rocks.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some bulls are rocks.

Some rocks are stones.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bdbab6e5d82585fe9c3e2d06ffdbba07ced7cbbf1f99ca93a9cc6c5bdb9f814.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6131ccf060ba390dc0824f3e119ff7cd8d990ca91433739a2c6d0e8a876072a6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bulls are stones - **False** (Because, the statements only establish a partial relationship between bulls and rocks, and a partial relationship between rocks and stones. There is no direct or indirect relationship that necessarily implies some bulls are stones)

II. All stones are rocks - **False** (Because, the statement "Some rocks are stones" indicates that only a portion of rocks are stones. It does not imply that all stones belong to the category of rocks. There could be stones that are not rocks.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2.**"

questions.question:
37 is related to 89 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 43 is related to 101.

To which of the following is 28 related, following the same logic?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbersinto its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here:

**1st number × 2 + 15 = 2nd number**

Given

37 is related to 89

⇒ 37 × 2 + 15 = 74 + 15 = 89 = 2nd number

And

43 is related to 101.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

Some trees are blue.

All blue is green.

Conclusions:

(I) All trees are blue.

(II) Some trees are green.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some trees are blue.

All blue is green.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc301b6c9281fc052e2a525ef885bffc17efbc76f1eca8c7179dcacab41d9e2a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/838c60b61146f855857ef70bb676ca20230ead68d7317a8ae80d2ef4cdcfe5bb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All trees are blue - **False** (Because, the statement "Some trees are blue" indicates that only a portion of trees are blue. It does not imply that all trees belong to the category of blue. There could be trees that are not blue.)

II. Some trees are green - **True** (Because, the statement "All blue is green" means that the entire category of 'blue' is contained within the category of 'green'. Since there are some trees that are blue, those trees that fall in the overlapping region between 'trees' and 'blue' must also fall within the 'green' category. Therefore, some trees are necessarily green.)

So, **Only conclusion II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4."**
